name: agentguards-claude
description: LLM security guardrails for Claude Code — jailbreak detection, prompt-injection and web-content scanning, data-exfiltration blocking, and destructive-command authorization. Bundles the AgentGuards MCP server plus enforcing hooks.

agentguards_api_key.title: AgentGuards API key
agentguards_api_key.description: Optional fallback for the hooks when AGENTGUARDS_API_KEY is not set in the environment. The bundled MCP server always reads the environment variable, so prefer setting AGENTGUARDS_API_KEY in your shell profile, or in the "env" block of ~/.claude/settings.json if you have no shell.
